name: tripsync
description: TripSync: collaborative trip planning and expense sharing (college full-stack project).

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors yellow,cyan --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w client && npm run deploy -w server
scripts.preview:worker: npm run build -w client && npm run preview:worker -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && node checks/slopGuard.mjs --self-test
